content.title: Why Instacart (CART) Shares Are Getting Obliterated Today
content.summary: Shares of online grocery delivery platform Instacart (NASDAQ:CART) fell 7.5% in the morning session after analysts from Wedbush expressed a bearish view on the company, citing fierce competition and reports of declining performance metrics. Wedbush assigned the company an "Underperform" rating, pointing to the threat from major retailers like Amazon and Walmart.

content.title: Amazon Grocery Push Seen Gaining Momentum. What That Means For Instacart, DoorDash.
content.summary: Amazon is seeing strong growth in perishable goods sales after revamping its grocery offering late last year, a Morgan Stanley analyst said.  Amazon stock rose Friday.  Morgan Stanley analyst Brian Nowak said third-party data from research firm Numerator showed Amazon's meat and perishable sales doubled year-over-year during some weeks in the second half of 2025, compared with single-digit percentage growth in the first half of the year.
